'''Kitt Corca''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Galactic War]] who worked at [[Star Cluster Casino]] during a [[Soovada]] event.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kitt Corca appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a Nightlife event vendor.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
